comment: The coverage ledger (docs/design/breadth.md §3; read by scripts/coverage.mjs, checked by tests/coverage.test.mjs). `censuses`: graph censuses taken natively in a QA copy by qa.graph-census; a member counts as verified on that build when a census shows the native provider filled it. `verified`: members shown natively by a check, with the build, the date and the proof (a file in this repository, with an optional anchor). `excluded`: members left out on purpose, with the reason. A member is `Type` (the type itself), `Type.member`, `Type.state` (its card's core state), `Type.core` (its card's core members) or `Type.*` (all its members).

excluded.reason: Not realizable natively yet (breadth.md D2): the app has no read API for command, edit or network rules, the tool and app approval modes in the config carry no creation time or origin approval, and the native provider never writes standing permissions (approve always is refused). Revisit with F9 (the agent's configuration) in D10.
